TASHKENTSPIRE2-MARK.title: Mark
TASHKENTSPIRE2-MARK.description: When taking Attack damage, increase that damage by the number of [gold]Mark[/gold] stacks, then lose [blue]1[/blue] stack.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-TORPEDO.title: Torpedo
TASHKENTSPIRE2-TORPEDO.description:
At the end of the turn, a Torpedo deals damage to the enemy with the most [gold]Mark[/gold].
Its timing is determined by your [gold]Distance[/gold] when it is [gold]launched[/gold].
Its damage is increased by the target's [gold]Mark[/gold].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-CHARGE.title: Charge
TASHKENTSPIRE2-CHARGE.description: Increase your Distance, up to a maximum of [blue]5[/blue].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-RETREAT.title: Retreat
TASHKENTSPIRE2-RETREAT.description: Decrease your Distance, down to a minimum of [blue]-5[/blue].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-AMMU.title: Ammo
TASHKENTSPIRE2-AMMU.description:
Current Ammo / Maximum Ammo.
Spend Ammo during combat to perform effects marked with [red]Repeat[/red].
Ammo is retained between combats.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-AMMU-MAX.title: Maximum Ammo
TASHKENTSPIRE2-AMMU-MAX.description: The maximum amount of Ammo this card can hold.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-LOAD.title: Load
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SHOT.title: Fire
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SHOT.description: Spend at least this much [gold]Ammo[/gold] to trigger the additional effect.
